results.note: Joint penalized score likelihood, fixed half-life/ridge, development-only selection; no production model saved. Outcome probabilities use full-support Skellam on independent-component rates plus exact four-cell Dixon-Coles corrections where applicable; shared-component counts cancel from the difference.

final_fit.estimation_scope: Bounded penalized point fit with fixed ridge; no learned hierarchical scale, mixture prior, posterior predictive samples or uncertainty intervals.
final_fit.goal_rate_interpretation: Log predictors give marginal expected goals.
final_fit.neutral_venue_policy: Home effect always applies to the listed home team; no neutral-venue flag is consumed.
final_fit.outcome_probability_method: Infinite-support Skellam on independent-component rates with analytic DC correction where applicable; no truncated-grid renormalization.
final_fit.team_strengths_policy: All team log strengths fixed at zero; common home/away rates.

time_weighting.decay_rate_formula: log(2)/half_life_days for positive half-life; 0 when disabled
time_weighting.fit_normalization: weights sum to one before the penalized objective

final_fit.unseen_team_policy: Neutral log attack/defence=0, corresponding to the fitted geometric-average team; no future-team fitting.
